items.name: Swisscubing Cup Mental Breakdown II 2026

venue.name: [Swiss Games Museum](https://museedujeu.ch/)
venue.details: On the ground floor, entrance through the court

items.information: Le Swisscubing Cup Mental Breakdown fait partie de la [Swisscubing Cup 2026](https://swisscubing.ch/swisscubing-cup-2026/), qui se compose de plusieurs compétitions réparties sur toute l'année. Tout le monde est le bienvenu, que vous souhaitiez ou non participer à la finale de la Swisscubing Cup. Pour cette compétition, **les points de qualification pour la finale de la Swisscubing Cup 2026 ne peuvent être cumulés que dans les disciplines suivantes : 3BLD, 4BLD, 5BLD, Multi-Blind et FMC.** Toutes les autres disciplines présentes lors de cette compétition ne font pas partie de la Swisscubing Cup. **Note aux débutants :** Cette compétition s'adresse prioritairement aux compétiteurs expérimentés et est organisée en conséquence. Bien que les débutants soient les bienvenus, l'expérience montre que peu d'autres néophytes participent à ce tournoi spécifique. Pour une première expérience en compétition, un tournoi plus "accessible" est souvent un choix plus agréable. __________________________ Der Swisscubing Cup Mental Breakdown ist Teil des [Swisscubing Cup 2026](https://swisscubing.ch/swisscubing-cup-2026/). Dieser besteht aus mehreren Competitions über das ganze Jahr verteilt. Jeder ist willkommen, unabhängig davon ob Interesse besteht, am Swisscubing Cup Finale teilzunehmen. **Punkte für die Qualifikation für das Swisscubing Cup 2026 Finale können bei dieser Competition nur in den folgenden Disziplinen gesammelt werden: 3BLD, 4-Blind, 5-Blind, Multiblind, FMC.** Alle anderen Disziplinen an dieser Competition sind nicht Teil des Swisscubing Cups. **Hinweis für Neulinge:** Diese Competition richtet sich in erster Linie an erfahrene Speedcuber und ist entsprechend organisiert. Zwar sind Neulinge willkommen, an diesem Turnier nehmen erfahrungsgemäss nur wenige andere Einsteiger teil. Für den ersten Competition-Besuch ist ein einsteigerfreundlicheres Turnier oft die angenehmere Wahl. ______________________________________________________________________________________________ Swisscubing Cup Mental Breakdown is part of the [Swisscubing Cup 2026](https://swisscubing.ch/swisscubing-cup-2026/), made of multiple competitions during the whole year. Everyone is welcome to compete, regardless of whether they are interested in taking part in the Swisscubing Cup final. **Points for qualifying for the Swisscubing Cup 2026 Finals can only be collected at this competition in the following events: 3BLD, 4-Blind, 5-Blind, Multiblind, FMC.** All other events at this competition are not part of the Swisscubing Cup. **Note for newcomers:** This competition is primarily aimed at experienced speedcubers. While newcomers are welcome, there will be only a small number of other beginners attending this event. For a first competition, a more beginner-friendly event is often the more enjoyable choice.

items.information: ### Outside Food not permitted### This venue does **not** allow anyone to bring outside food or drinks in. Bringing in water is allowed. The venue's concession will be open. We apologize for the inconvenience and we thank you for your cooperation. **Registration Reminders** You must register and pay the registration fee before your registration can be accepted. **Unpaid registrations will not be accepted**. ​ Since this is a "favourites" competition, you may choose **at most five (5) events**. ​ Please review all of the tabs listed on this website. Attendance is not required for the entire competition. However, **please arrive at least 15 minutes before the events that you compete in or help in are planned to start**. Please bring your own puzzles for the events you are competing in. ​ Once your registration has been accepted, you will no longer be able to change your events by yourself. If you would like to change them, send the organization team an email and we will change your events for you as long as you inform us before September 11, 2026 at 6:00 PM MST. ​ **First-Time Competitors: All newcomers must be familiar with the WCA Regulations before competing.** There is a video [here](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dPL3eV-A0ww&t=2s&ab_channel=cyotheking) for a basic overview of the rules. ​ **Notice of Filming and Photography** Attendees of competitions consent to their images being used by SpeedCubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.

items.information: **Español** Esta es la primera competencia organizada en esta sede y también será la primera competencia oficial del año en Quetzaltenango. Kukulcán Open 2026 será una competencia oficial de la World Cube Association (WCA), inspirada en la cultura maya y en la figura de Kukulcán, uno de los símbolos más representativos de Mesoamérica. Nuestro objetivo es ofrecer una experiencia competitiva de alta calidad, promoviendo la comunidad del speedcubing en el occidente de Guatemala y mostrando parte de nuestra identidad y cultura a todos los participantes. Esta competencia se llevará a cabo en dos locaciones diferentes. Para consultar la ubicación correspondiente a cada día, revisa la pestaña “Distribución de áreas / Venue Layout”, donde se indica la ubicación de la competencia para el viernes 11, así como para los días sábado 12 y domingo 13. ¡Sean todos bienvenidos a Quetzaltenango y esperamos que disfruten de Kukulcán Open 2026! **English** This is the first competition organized at this venue and also the first official WCA competition of the year in Quetzaltenango. Kukulcán Open 2026 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) competition inspired by the Mayan culture and Kukulcán, one of the most iconic symbols of Mesoamerica. Our goal is to provide a high-quality competition while helping grow the speedcubing community in western Guatemala and sharing part of our culture and identity with every participant. This competition will take place at two different venues. Please refer to the “Distribución de áreas / Venue Layout” tab to find the competition location for Friday the 11th, as well as for Saturday the 12th and Sunday the 13th. Welcome to Quetzaltenango—we hope you enjoy Kukulcán Open 2026! ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MjA2Njg3LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--be50ae158823f554eaf24566a8f1a7aa4c6d9eb2/IMG_4169.png)

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTk4MjA5LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--972806504f8e67211ebc816281b9ddf1b8bf11e5/MOLOLOA.png) ###### Español ¡Bienvenidos al Mololoa Open 2026, otra competencia en el hermoso estado de **Nayarit**!. Este evento emocionante y lleno de velocidad se llevará a cabo en la ciudad de Tepic los días sábado 29 y domingo 30 de agosto de 2026. El Mololoa Open 2026 reunirá a cuberos de todo el estado de Nayarit y más allá, brindándoles la oportunidad de mostrar su destreza y competir en una variedad de eventos. Tanto si eres un principiante como un profesional experimentado, este torneo ofrece una oportunidad para que todos participen y se diviertan. Esta competencia es reconocida como una competencia oficial de la Asociación Mundial del Cubo. Por lo tanto, todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados y entender el [reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/) antes de la competencia. **AVISO DE FILMACIÓN Y FOTOGRAFÍA** En este evento se tomarán fotografías y videos que podrán ser usados por la Asociación Mexicana de Speedcubing con fines de promoción, documentación y difusión de nuestras actividades. Al asistir, autorizas el uso de tu imagen en los términos de nuestro Aviso de Privacidad. 📄 Consúltalo aquí 👉 www.amscubing.org/privacidad/ ###### English Welcome to Mololoa Open 2026, another competition in the beautiful state of **Nayarit**! This exciting and high-speed event will take place in the city of Tepic on Saturday, Aug 29, and Sunday, Aug 30, 2026. Mololoa Open 2026 will bring together cubers from across the state of Nayarit and beyond, providing them with the opportunity to showcase their skills and compete in a variety of events. Whether you are a beginner or an experienced professional, this tournament offers a chance for everyone to participate and have fun. This competition is recognized as an official event by the World Cube Association. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with and understand the [WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) before the competition. **NOTICE OF FILMING AND PHOTOGRAPHY** Photos and videos will be taken at this event, which may be used by Asociación Mexicana de Speedcubing for promotion, documentation, and dissemination of our activities. By attending, you authorize the use of your image under the terms of our Privacy Notice. 📄 Check it here 👉 www.amscubing.org/privacidad/

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTcxNjY5LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--a8ab6aa393063e4885b78fe22730fbdb06d76ab9/Kewbz%20UKC26%20LOGO.jpg) ## Welcome to the Kewbz UK Championship 2026! ### This year's UK National Championship! #### Please read ALL tabs before registering. ##### Spectators are welcome to attend for free. There's no need to pre-book - feel free to drop in whenever you wish! **Free T-Shirt:** By registering and attending the Kewbz UK Championship 2026, you'll receive a Kewbz UK Championship 2026 T-shirt as a memento! **Please fill in your registration comment with your T-shirt size.** **Newcomers:** This competition is open to first-time competitors, who will only be able to compete in 3x3, 2x2, Pyraminx, Skewb, and 3x3 One-Handed. If you would like to attempt to qualify for other events, you must do so another competition first. You can see all upcoming UK competitions [here](https://wca.ukca.org). **Qualification Requirements:** If you do not meet the qualification requirements outlined in the [Events tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KewbzUKChampionship2026#competition-events) in an official WCA competition by August 16th you will not be eligible to compete in those events. You will not be able to add events to your registration which you do not qualify for, but can update your registration if you later qualify for them. Please note that **there are no qualifications for 3x3, 2x2, Pyraminx, Skewb, or 3x3 One-Handed.** **Final Round Advancements:** The top 8 UK competitors will be guaranteed to progress into the finals for all events. In 3x3, any non-UK competitors faster than the 8th UK competitor will compete together, before UK competitors face off in seeded pairs. In other events, all 16 finalists will compete together, with the [top 8 UK competitors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#9p2b) being joined by the 8 remaining best competitors from any region. **Fewest Moves, 4x4 Blindfolded, 5x5 Blindfolded, 3x3 Multi-Blind:** These events will **not** be held at this competition. To compete for the national champion title for these events, you must compete at the [Kewbz UK Championship FMC 2026](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KewbzUKChampionshipFMC2026) or the [Kewbz UK Blindfolded Championship 2026](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KewbzUKBLDChampionship2026). The podium winners of these competition will be awarded their prize during the awards at Kewbz UK Championship 2026. **Prizes Eligiblity:** As this is the UK National Championship, only competitors who represent the United Kingdom will be eligible for prizes. The competition remains open for all nationalities to compete. **Filming and Photography:** Filming and photography will take place at the event. By entering the event premises, you acknowledge that you have been informed you may be photographed and recorded for media to be used by the UKCA and its partners.

Please read the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations) before the competition. items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTk4NDUxLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--6547f5d596befc73699700f8fea7d96dde8f8efb/SpeedcubingAustria_Logo_comp_page.png) English version is below Deutsch: Wir freuen uns sehr euch Langenstein Summer 2026 als ein offizielles WCA Turnier ankündigen zu können. Die Speedcubing Competition wird organisiert von Simon Praschl, Martin Fröhlich, Philipp Leimer, Thomas Strasser und Speedcubing Austria - sowie delegiert von Pranjal Khan, Fabian Staber und Jan Křížka. Diesmal findet die Competition in der Eisstockhalle in Langenstein statt. Die Resultate dieser Competition werden zu den offiziellen WCA World Rankings hinzugefügt. Jeder ist bei diesem Turnier gerne willkommen, unabhängig von der Erfahrung, Alter oder sonstigen Fähigkeiten. Manche Events haben ein spezifisches Zeitlimit, damit wir sicherstellen können den ganzen Tag über im Zeitplan zu bleiben. Es dürfen Puzzles jeder Marke verwendet werden solange sie den WCA Richtlinien entsprechen. Es sind alle Herzlich willkommen! Jeder Teilnehmer darf einen Gast mitbringen. Wir freuen uns besonders auf neue Speedcuber aus Österreich! English: We are happy to announce the Langenstein Summer 2026 as an official WCA Competition. The speedcubing competition is organised by Simon Praschl, Martin Fröhlich, Philipp Leimer and Thomas Strasser and delegated by Pranjal Khan, Fabian Staber and Jan Křížka. Results of the competition will be added to the official WCA World Rankings. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the day on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors must be familiar with the WCA Regulations. Any puzzle brand may be used during the competition, as long as it complies with the WCA regulations. Every Competitor can bring one guest.

items.name: Svealandsmästerskapet 2026
items.information: Välkomna till Svealandsmästerskapet 2026! Alla är varmt välkomna att delta, oavsett om du löser kuben på 5 sekunder eller 5 minuter. Notera dock att det endast är deltagare som bor i Svealand som kan vinna titlar och priser på Svealandsmästerskapet, läs mer om detta under fliken "[Regionala Mästerskap](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/Svealandsmasterskapet2026#76045-regionala-masterskap-2026-regional-championships-2026)". Vi ber er läsa igenom alla flikar på denna sida eftersom de innehåller mycket värdefull information. ----- Welcome to Svealandsmästerskapet 2026! Everyone is welcome to participate, whether you solve the cube in 5 seconds or 5 minutes. Note, however, that only competitors who live in Svealand can win titles and prizes at the Svealand Championship, read more about this under the tab "[Regional Championships](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/Svealandsmasterskapet2026#76045-regionala-masterskap-2026-regional-championships-2026)". We ask you to read through all the tabs on this page as they contain very valuable information. [![](https://cuboss.se/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/cuboss-svekub-loggor.png)](https://svekub.se/om_oss/svekub-cuboss/)

items.information: ![](https://i.imgur.com/y4aZ08M.png) **Polski:** Zapraszamy na czwartą edycję Silesian Minx Fest - wyjątkowych zawodów z minxami na wolnym powietrzu! Wydarzenie jest organizowane dzięki wsparciu Wojewódzkiej Biblioteki Publicznej im. Emanuela Smołki w Opolu! Zapoznaj się ze wszystkimi zakładkami przed rejestracją. items.name: Sleep & Solve Landsbro 2026
items.information: Varmt välkomna till Sleep & Solve Landsbro 2026! Sveriges sista tävling innan Europeiska Mästerskapet i Nederländerna! Första tävlingen någonsin som erbjuder övernattning i vindskydd! Alla är varmt välkomna att delta, oavsett om du löser kuben på 5 sekunder eller 5 minuter samt oavsett tidigare tävlingserfarenhet. Vi ber er läsa igenom alla flikar på denna sida eftersom de innehåller mycket värdefull information. ----- Welcome to Sleep & Solve Landsbro 2026! Sweden's last competition before the European Championships in the Netherlands! First competition ever to offer overnight stays in outdoor wind shelters! Everyone is welcome to participate, regardless of whether you solve the cube in 5 seconds or 5 minutes and regardless of prior competition experience. We ask you to read through all the tabs on this page as they contain very valuable information. [![](https://cuboss.se/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/cuboss-svekub-loggor.png)](https://svekub.se/om_oss/svekub-cuboss/)

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTcwNzI3LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--13dfeb24cd84691482a5e959d5d9cfe724e70bca/image.png) #![Bandera ESP](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBb0E5IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--c7812c9b5d2929fb4ed7644517bf4f9800a3d1e4/esp.png) * Los socios de la AES (Asociación Española de Speedcubing) recibirán un descuento del 15%. Puedes hacerte socio de la AES [aquí](https://speedcubingspain.org/register/). * Los socios de la AGS (Asociación Galega de Speedcubing) recibirán un descuento del 15%. Puedes hacerte socio de la [AGS](https://www.galiciaspeedcubing.org/) de forma presencial en el campeonato. Para los descuentos, el pago se debe hacer como todos los competidores y tras la competición se devolverá el importe de los descuentos. Al registrarte en esta competición aceptas que se te enviarán correos electrónicos informativos y se te podrá solicitar confirmación de asistencia mediante correo electrónico. **Si no se recibe dicha confirmación, tu registro puede ser anulado sin reembolso.** Por favor, leed los correos que os enviemos antes de la competición ya que pueden contener información **importante**. Además, todos los competidores deben leer las pestañas de [Información Importante](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/VigoOpen2026#72861-informacion-importante-important-information) y de Preguntas Más Frecuentes ([PMF](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/VigoOpen2026#72860-preguntas-frecuentes-faq) para el correcto desarrollo de la competición. Un registro se considera completo una vez se ha realizado el pago correspondiente. Los registros completos serán aceptados manualmente en orden de pago y aparecerán en la lista de competidores hasta alcanzar el límite de competidores. Una vez alcanzado este límite los registros completos serán añadidos a la [lista de espera](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/VigoOpen2026#72865-lista-de-espera-waiting-list). #![Bandera GAL](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTk1NDY2LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--1d55857fc84f004f1a94c2a3ddbc1ad3a591c62f/1F3F4-E0065-E0073-E0067-E0061-E007F_color.png) * Os socios da AES (Asociación Española de Speedcubing) recibirán un desconto do 15%. Podes facerte socio da AES aquí. * Os socios da AGS (Asociación Galega de Speedcubing) recibirán un desconto do 15%. Podes facerte socio da AGS de forma presencial no campionato. Para aplicar os descontos, o pago debe facerse igual que o resto dos competidores e, despois da competición, devolverase o importe correspondente aos descontos. Ao rexistrarte nesta competición aceptas que se che enviarán correos electrónicos informativos e que se che poderá solicitar confirmación de asistencia mediante correo electrónico. Se non se recibe esa confirmación, o teu rexistro pode ser anulado sen reembolso. Por favor, lede os correos que vos enviemos antes da competición, xa que poden conter información importante. Ademais, todos os competidores deben ler as lapelas de Información Importante e de Preguntas Máis Frecuentes (PMF) para o correcto desenvolvemento da competición. Un rexistro considérase completo unha vez realizado o pago correspondente. Os rexistros completos serán aceptados manualmente por orde de pago e aparecerán na lista de competidores ata acadar o límite establecido. Unha vez alcanzado este límite, os rexistros completos serán engadidos á lista de espera. #![Bandera UK](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBb0U5IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--2a28e3c285bf55a2606838971abb0514d0ef172c/UK.png) * The AES members (Spanish Association) will receive a 15% discount. You can become a member of the AES [here](https://speedcubingspain.org/register/). * The AGS members (Galician Association) will receive a 15% discount. You can become a member of the [AGS](https://www.galiciaspeedcubing.org/) at the competition. For discounts, the payment must be made as all other competitors and after the competition the discounts will be returned. By registering to this competition you accept that informative emails will be sent to you and you might be asked for an attendance confirmation via email. **If said confirmation is not received, your registration may be deleted without refund.** Please, read the emails that we will send to you before the competitions since they may include **important** information. Moreover, all the competitors must read the [Important Information](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/VigoOpen2026#72861-informacion-importante-important-information) and Frequently Asked Questions ([FAQ](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/VigoOpen2026#72860-preguntas-frecuentes-faq) tabs for the correct development of the competition. A registration is considered completed once the fee has been paid. Completed registrations will be accepted manually in order of payment and they will appear on the competitors list until the competitor limit is reached. Once this limit is reached completed registrations will be added to the [waiting list](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/VigoOpen2026#72865-lista-de-espera-waiting-list). ​

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTg3NzY1LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--f44dd6d62a3dea247e35f6fcd4b2cb337598298b/WhatsApp%20Image%202026-05-26%20at%2015.18.14.jpeg) ¡Te invitamos a celebrar con nosotros el 10.º aniversario de esta gran competencia de cubos! Queremos que vuelvas a compartir la emoción, la convivencia y la pasión por el speedcubing como la primera vez. Acompáñanos a revivir recuerdos y crear nuevos momentos juntos. ¡No te lo puedes perder! Esta competencia es reconocida como una competencia oficial de la Asociación Mundial de Cubos. Por lo tanto, todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados y entender el [reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/) antes de la competencia. **AVISO DE FILMACIÓN Y FOTOGRAFÍA** En este evento se tomarán fotografías y videos que podrán ser usados por la [Asociación Mexicana de Speedcubing](https://amscubing.org/) con fines de promoción, documentación y difusión de nuestras actividades. Al asistir, autorizas el uso de tu imagen en los términos de nuestro Aviso de Privacidad. 📄 Consúltalo aquí 👉 www.amscubing.org/privacidad/ We invite you to celebrate the 10th anniversary of this amazing cubing competition with us! Come and share once again the excitement, friendship, and passion for speedcubing just like the very first time. Join us to relive great memories and create new ones together. Don’t miss it! This competition is recognized as an official competition of the World Cube Association. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with and understand the [WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) prior to competition. **NOTICE OF FILMING AND PHOTOGRAPHY** Photos and videos will be taken at this event, which may be used by [Asociación Mexicana de Speedcubing](https://amscubing.org/) for promotion, documentation, and dissemination of our activities. items.information: Zapraszamy na kolejne zawody organizowane w poznańskim klubie snookerowym BrizZon! Nie możemy się już ciebie doczekać! We invite you to the next competition organized in the BrizZon snooker club in Poznań! This time the competition will take place not as part of the standard series of tournaments, but in five demanding competitions - FM, 3-5 BLD and MBLD is a classic set that will give many competitors a headache. We are looking forward to you!

items.name: Hannover Mental Breakdown 2026
items.information: Herzlich Willkommen zur ersten Mental Breakdown Competition in Hannover. Wir freuen uns auf einen Tag voller geistiger Höchstleitungen mit euch. **Hinweis für Neulinge:** Dieser Wettbewerb ist auf das Blindlösen von Zauberwürfeln und die Disziplin FMC (Lösen in möglichst wenig Zügen) fokussiert. Das "normale" Lösen mit offenen Augen wird bei diesem Wettkampf nicht angeboten. Bitte melde dich nur an, wenn du am Blindlösen und/oder in FMC teilnehmen möchtest. Ansonsten bist du natürlich gerne als Zuschauer willkommen. Welcome to the first Mental Breakdown Competition in Hanover. We look forward to a day full of mental feats with you. **Note for newcomers:** This competition focuses on blind solving of Rubik's cubes and the discipline FMC (solving in as few moves as possible). “Normal” solving with eyes open is not offered in this competition. Please only register if you want to participate in blind solving and/or FMC. items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTg0OTc5LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--34df290ff4fde0c20068f1bf6100bcd14e2552f7/e0877ba5-bb31-49b1-b43a-67619e510cab.jpg) # Welcome to **Greenwoods Big Blind and Beyond 2026**! # This competition features **4BLD** as the main event and will take place right after **[FMC World 2026](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FMCWorld2026)** in the morning. It is also the **first competition in the Philippines to feature two rounds of 4BLD**. The competition includes official events such as **7x7, Clock, 3BLD, and MBLD,** with a focus on big cubes and blindfolded events. **No 3x3 event will be held**, as this competition is designed for specialists in quiet events. Unofficial events include **Master Magic** and **Pyraminx One-Handed**. Please check the **[Unofficial Events](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/GBBB2026#74010-unofficial-events-info-registration)** tab for more details. This competition marks the third Greenwoods competition of the year, following **[Greenwoods Clock Clash 2026](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/GreenwoodsClockClash2026)** and **[Greenwoods Summer Overtime 2026](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/GreenwoodsSummerOvertime2026)**, continuing the series of uniquely themed events in the community. We encourage all competitors and guests to review the information tabs for details on the **schedule, regulations, venue guidelines**, and **registration** to help ensure a smooth and well-organized competition. We look forward to seeing you—join us for a day of focused, quiet solving, where blindfolds are on and every solve is all about memory and precision.

items.information: Välkomna till Take Your Time Bergshamra 2026! **Notera att tävlingen hålls i Bergshamra utanför Norrtälje, inte Bergshamra norr om centrala Stockholm!** Alla är varmt välkomna att delta, oavsett om du löser kuben på 5 sekunder eller 5 minuter samt oavsett tidigare tävlingserfarenhet. Vi ber er läsa igenom alla flikar på denna sida eftersom de innehåller mycket värdefull information. **OBS:** Grenarna 6x6x6, 7x7x7 och Megaminx kan **inte** kombineras med grenarna 3x3x3 BLD, 4x4x4 BLD och 5x5x5 BLD. Detta innebär att du exempelvis **inte** kan ställa upp i både Megaminx och 3x3x3 BLD, men att du kan ställa upp i både Megaminx och 7x7x7. **OBS:** Maximalt en gäst / medföljande per deltagare på grund av tävlingslokalens storlek. Ingen utomstående publik tillåten. ----- Welcome to Take Your Time Bergshamra 2026! Everyone is welcome to participate, regardless of whether you solve the cube in 5 seconds or 5 minutes and regardless of prior competition experience. items.name: Swisscubing Cup Mental Breakdown I 2026
items.information: Der Swisscubing Cup Mental Breakdown ist Teil des [Swisscubing Cup 2026](https://swisscubing.ch/swisscubing-cup-2026/). Dieser besteht aus mehreren Competitions über das ganze Jahr verteilt. Jeder ist willkommen, unabhängig davon ob Interesse besteht, am Swisscubing Cup Finale teilzunehmen. **Punkte für die Qualifikation für das Swisscubing Cup 2026 Finale können bei dieser Competition nur in den folgenden Disziplinen gesammelt werden: 3BLD, 4-Blind, 5-Blind, Multiblind, FMC.** Alle anderen Disziplinen an dieser Competition sind nicht Teil des Swisscubing Cups. **Hinweis für Neulinge:** Diese Competition richtet sich in erster Linie an erfahrene Speedcuber und ist entsprechend organisiert. Zwar sind Neulinge willkommen, an diesem Turnier nehmen erfahrungsgemäss nur wenige andere Einsteiger teil. Für den ersten Competition-Besuch ist ein einsteigerfreundlicheres Turnier oft die angenehmere Wahl. ______________________________________________________________________________________________ Swisscubing Cup Mental Breakdown is part of the [Swisscubing Cup 2026](https://swisscubing.ch/swisscubing-cup-2026/), made of multiple competitions during the whole year. Everyone is welcome to compete, regardless of whether they are interested in taking part in the Swisscubing Cup final. **Points for qualifying for the Swisscubing Cup 2026 Finals can only be collected at this competition in the following events: 3BLD, 4-Blind, 5-Blind, Multiblind, FMC.** All other events at this competition are not part of the Swisscubing Cup. **Note for newcomers:** This competition is primarily aimed at experienced speedcubers. While newcomers are welcome, there will be only a small number of other beginners attending this event. For a first competition, a more beginner-friendly event is often the more enjoyable choice.

items.name: Franconia Cube Days 2026
items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTc1ODE1LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--a5b97380e04dc31adffc60a72bbfc202cab42c5f/FCD.jpg) ###Liebe Speedcuber/innen, Wir laden Euch herzlich zu den Franconia Cube Days 2026 ein. Diese Competition ist der direkte Nachfolger der "Frankfurt Cube Days", die von 2012 bis 2024 stattfanden. Nun sind wir nicht allzu weit umgezogen in die Nähe von Nürnberg, wo wir wieder eine tolle Venue gefunden haben. Wie in der Vergangenheit möchten wir sowohl Anfängern, als auch erfahrenen Cubern eine gute Erfahrung ermöglichen. Die Events 3x3, 4x4, 5x5, 6x6 und OH werden im neuen Format "dual rounds" stattfinden, sofern das WCA Softwaresystem dies bis dahin unterstützt. Am Samstag Abend wird es wieder eine After-Comp geben, ganztägig Snacks und Getränke in der Venue und eine Cubing-Börse. Mehr dazu könnt ihr in den Tabs nachlesen. Wir feuen uns auf Euch. ###Dear competitors, Franconia Cube Days 2026 are open to every citizen from every nation. This competition is a direct successor of the "Frankfurt Cube Days" that originated in 2012. The new venue is near Nürnberg, which has good trafic connections by plane, train or car. Our goal is to create a great experience for beginners and advanced cubers aswell. You can stay at our "After-Comp" on saturday evening to have fun and to connect with other cubers. There will be snacks and beverages at the venue and also a cube-swap shop. Please have a look at the tabs for more information. We are looking forward to see you at the FCDs 2026.

items.information: **CubingZA** is excited to announce Benoni May Madness 2026!! Don't forget that to participate you need to register for the competition in the "Register" tab, and pay for your ticket to confirm your entry. Please see Registration Requirements below for instructions and when registration opens. We will be having an odd mix of main, side and blind events in this One Day, One Stop, All-Out Total Non-Stop Action-Based Competition so be sure to stick around for all sorts of weird and unique tastes of skill, fortitude and perseverance!! **All New Competitors** If this is your first time competing, or the first time your child or ward is competing, please ensure to bring with ID (card, book, passport, birth certificate) so that we can verify that the name is spelled correctly, the Date of Birth is correct, and the Nationality is correct. Please also ensure you have all the puzzles you need to compete - we do not supply puzzles for competitors. You are welcome to ask other competitors if you can borrow their puzzle for a certain event, but there is no guarantee. **Food and Drinks** Mova Coffee and Sweet N' Sweet will be available from the morning selling food and drinks. They will be around for the duration of the competition so be sure to get your food in between rounds and during lunch because part of being your own champion is competing at your best and not on an empty stomach!!!

items.name: Hessen Open 2026
items.information: Hessen Open 2026 ist eine Zwei-Tages-Competition und Partner-Competition von Hessen Mini Open 2026, die am gleichen Wochenende, freitags, stattfinden wird. Bitte beachte, dass du nur an einem der beiden Wettbewerbe teilnehmen kannst. Wenn du dich für beide Wettbewerbe anmeldest, so zählt nur die erste Anmeldung und wir werden die zweite (spätere) Anmeldung unverzüglich löschen. Hessen Open 2026 is open to every citizen from every nation. Hessen Open 2026 is a two-day competition and series competition to Hessen Mini Open 2026, which will be held at the same weekend, on friday. Please note that you can only compete in one of the two competitions. If you register for both competitions, only the first registration will be valid and we will immediately delete the second (later) registration.

items.information: Välkomna till den tredje upplagan av Örebro Side Events! Notera att varken 3x3 eller de andra mest populära grenarna hålls på denna tävling. Denna tävling kommer också att inkludera inofficiella grenar, regler och resultat hittas på [**Cubing Contests**](https://cubingcontests.com). Läs mer under fliken Inofficiella Grenar. Please note that neither 3x3 nor the other most popular events will be held at this competition. Regardless, everyone is of course welcome to participate, whether you solve the cube in 5 seconds or 5 minutes and regardless of prior competition experience. items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTYyNzIzLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--bf638126f96e668f65b37e3ce68edb80c6d49543/upen%20(1).png) ###### Español ¡Bienvenidos al UPEN Open 2026, otra competencia en el hermoso estado de Nayarit!. Este evento emocionante y lleno de velocidad se llevará a cabo en la ciudad de Tepic los días sábado 16 y domingo 17 de mayo de 2026. El UPEN Open 2026 reunirá a cuberos de todo el estado de Nayarit y más allá, brindándoles la oportunidad de mostrar su destreza y competir en una variedad de eventos. Tanto si eres un principiante como un profesional experimentado, este torneo ofrece una oportunidad para que todos participen y se diviertan. Esta competencia es reconocida como una competencia oficial de la Asociación Mundial del Cubo. Por lo tanto, todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados y entender el[ reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/) antes de la competencia. **AVISO DE FILMACIÓN Y FOTOGRAFÍA** En este evento se tomarán fotografías y videos que podrán ser usados por la [Asociación Mexicana de Speedcubing](https://amscubing.org/) con fines de promoción, documentación y difusión de nuestras actividades. Al asistir, autorizas el uso de tu imagen en los términos de nuestro Aviso de Privacidad. 📄 Consúltalo aquí 👉 www.amscubing.org/privacidad/ ###### English Welcome to UPEN Open 2026, another competition in the beautiful state of Nayarit! This exciting and high-speed event will take place in the city of Tepic on Saturday, May 16, and Sunday, May 17, 2026. UPEN Open 2026 will bring together cubers from across the state of Nayarit and beyond, providing them with the opportunity to showcase their skills and compete in a variety of events. Whether you are a beginner or an experienced professional, this tournament offers a chance for everyone to participate and have fun. This competition is recognized as an official event by the World Cube Association. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with and understand the[ WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) before the competition. **NOTICE OF FILMING AND PHOTOGRAPHY** Photos and videos will be taken at this event, which may be used by [Asociación Mexicana de Speedcubing](https://amscubing.org/) for promotion, documentation, and dissemination of our activities. By attending, you authorize the use of your image under the terms of our Privacy Notice. 📄 Check it here 👉 www.amscubing.org/privacidad/

items.information: 🇧🇷 **Português** **Bem-vindos à segunda competição de Cubo Mágico do Planalto Médio do Rio Grande do Sul !!!!** Localizada no norte do Estado do Rio Grande do Sul, na região conhecida como Planalto Médio, a cidade de Passo Fundo destaca-se pela representatividade nas áreas médica, cultural, educacional, agrícola de precisão e tecnológica. Por estar localizada numa região estratégica do Rio Grande do Sul e próxima do centro e oeste de Santa Catarina, o Passo Fundo Cubing 2026 promete a consolidação do Cubo Mágico em um espaço pouco alcançado até o momento, trazendo a promessa de crescimento do esporte numa verdadeira expansão para os atletas que buscam as possibilidades de participação nos campeonatos oficiais. Agora chegou a vez de Passo Fundo consolidar a representatividade também em um Esporte da Mente! Divulgar esse esporte em nível oficial, e levar aos competidores a oportunidade de participação, é o objetivo solidário da organização e dos apoiadores, especialmente da Secretaria Municipal de Educação e da Prefeitura Municipal de Passo Fundo, que apoiam o evento! Nos vemos lá! 🇬🇧 **English:** **Welcome to the second speedcubing competition in Passo Fundo - Rio Grande do Sul !!!!** Located in the north of the state of Rio Grande do Sul, in the region known as "middle plateau", the city of Passo Fundo stands out due to its representation in medical, cultural, educational, precision farming and technology areas. Since it is located in a strategical region in Rio Grande do Sul and close to the center and West of the state of Santa Catarina, this competition is a certain path to introducing speedcubing somewhere not fully reached yet, with the promise of growth to the sport, bringing a chace of participating in official competitions. Now it is Passo Fundo's turn to reach its representation in the mind sport too! Spreading this sport officially and taking the opportunity to the competitors are the objectives of the organisers and supporters, especially of Secretaria Municipal de Educação and of Prefeitura Municipal de Passo Fundo, who support the event! We will meet there!

items.information: English version is below Deutsch: Wir freuen uns sehr euch Langenstein City Blind Open 2026 als ein offizielles WCA Turnier ankündigen zu können. Die Speedcubing Competition wird organisiert von Simon Praschl, Martin Fröhlich, Philipp Leimer und Thomas Strasser und delegiert von Pranjal Khan, Fabian Staber und Jan Křížka. Diesmal findet die Competition in der Eisstockhalle in Langenstein statt. Die Resultate dieser Competition werden zu den offiziellen WCA World Rankings hinzugefügt. Jeder ist bei diesem Turnier gerne willkommen, unabhängig von der Erfahrung, Alter oder sonstigen Fähigkeiten. Manche Events haben ein spezifisches Zeitlimit, damit wir sicherstellen können den ganzen Tag über im Zeitplan zu bleiben. Es dürfen Puzzles jeder Marke verwendet werden solange sie den WCA Richtlinien entsprechen. Es sind alle Herzlich willkommen! Jeder Teilnehmer darf einen Gast mitbringen. Wir freuen uns besonders auf neue Speedcuber aus Österreich! English: We are happy to announce the Langenstein City Blind Open 2026 as an official WCA Competition. The speedcubing competition is organised by Simon Praschl, Martin Fröhlich, Philipp Leimer and Thomas Strasser and delegated by Pranjal Khan, Fabian Staber and Jan Křížka. Results of the competition will be added to the official WCA World Rankings. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the day on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors must be familiar with the WCA Regulations. Any puzzle brand may be used during the competition, as long as it complies with the WCA regulations. Every Competitor can bring one guest.

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTYyMjgzLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--ce5023c17fc9bf649fbe7e7c137c67c69bebbf8b/CaminosLeon.jpg) ##### *🎵"Bonito León, Guanajuato, la feria con su jugada, allí se apuesta la vida y se respeta al que gana..."🎶* ## Caminos de Guanajuato – León 2026 La ruta **"Caminos de Guanajuato"** comienza su recorrido en **León, Guanajuato**, un lugar que refleja el carácter y la riqueza cultural de nuestro estado, donde la historia, la tradición y la vida cotidiana se entrelazan en cada rincón. Este torneo forma parte de una travesía que celebra no solo el speedcubing, sino también la identidad cultural de nuestro estado, conectando distintas sedes bajo un mismo espíritu competitivo y festivo. En cada parada, la música de José Alfredo Jiménez acompaña simbólicamente el camino. Sus canciones, que han dado voz al sentir guanajuatense, inspiran esta edición dedicada a León. El **Guanajuato Rubik’s Team** estará encantado de recibirte con los brazos abiertos para compartir la pasión por el cubo y, al mismo tiempo, invitarte a conocer más sobre la historia del estado, sus municipios y el legado cultural que ha trascendido fronteras. Queremos que tu experiencia vaya más allá de la competencia: que sea también un encuentro con nuestras raíces, nuestras historias y nuestra música. Te esperamos en León para seguir construyendo juntos los **"Caminos de Guanajuato"**. Esta competencia es reconocida como una competencia oficial de la **Asociación Mundial de Cubos**. Por lo tanto, todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados y entender el [reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/) antes de la competencia. **AVISO DE FILMACIÓN Y FOTOGRAFÍA** En este evento se tomarán fotografías y videos que podrán ser usados por la [Asociación Mexicana de Speedcubing](https://amscubing.org/) con fines de promoción, documentación y difusión de nuestras actividades. Al asistir, autorizas el uso de tu imagen en los términos de nuestro Aviso de Privacidad. 📄 Consúltalo aquí 👉 www.amscubing.org/privacidad/ ## Caminos de Guanajuato – León 2026 The "Caminos de Guanajuato" route begins in **León, Guanajuato**, a place that reflects the character and cultural richness of our state, where history, tradition, and daily life intertwine in every corner. This tournament is part of a journey that celebrates not only speedcubing but also the cultural identity of our state, connecting different locations under the same competitive and festive spirit. At each stop, the music of José Alfredo Jiménez symbolically accompanies the journey. His songs, which have given voice to the Guanajuato spirit, inspire this edition dedicated to León. The **Guanajuato Rubik’s Team** will be delighted to welcome you with open arms to share the passion for the cube and, at the same time, invite you to learn more about the history of the state, its municipalities, and the cultural legacy that has transcended borders. We want your experience to go beyond the competition: we want it to also be an encounter with our roots, our stories, and our music. We look forward to seeing you in León to continue building the **"Caminos de Guanajuato"** together. This competition is recognized as an official competition of the **World Cube Association**. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with and understand the[ WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/) prior to competition. **NOTICE OF FILMING AND PHOTOGRAPHY** Photos and videos will be taken at this event, which may be used by [Asociación Mexicana de Speedcubing](https://amscubing.org/) for promotion, documentation, and dissemination of our activities. By attending, you authorize the use of your image under the terms of our Privacy Notice. 📄 Check it here 👉 www.amscubing.org/privacidad/

items.name: Teknostallen 2026
items.information: ### 🇳🇴 Teknostallen 2026 Gjør deg klar for en fin kubehelg når vi inviterer til konkurranse i Teknostallen i Trondheim 28.–29. mars! Dette blir en helg med ekte konkurransestemning, offisielle tider og masse energi. Arrangementet er for ALLE – enten du løser kuben på 3 sekunder eller 3 minutter, og enten du er 7 eller 70 år. Her skal både nybegynnere og erfarne speedcubers samles for å dele lidenskapen for kuben og jakten på nye personlige rekorder. Konkurransen går over to dager inne i den spektakulære tropiske hagen i Teknostallen, en helt unik ramme for raske fingre og raske hoder. Det konkurreres i mange ulike grener, fra klassisk 3x3 til flere andre varianter. Dette blir en helg fylt med mestring, spenning og ekte kubeglede. Man går inn hovedinngangen på Teknostallen, og venteområdet kommer til å være under messaninen, mens konkurransene foregår oppe på messaninen. Det er gode muligheter for å kjøpe både mat og drikke fra de ulike plassene på bygget som Mellom, Glød og Snurr. --- ### 🇺🇸 Teknostallen 2026 Get ready for a great cube weekend as we invite you to a competition at Teknostallen in Trondheim on March 28–29. This will be a weekend filled with real competition atmosphere, official timing and plenty of energy. The event is for EVERYONE – whether you solve the cube in 3 seconds or 3 minutes, and whether you are 7 or 70 years old. Both beginners and experienced speedcubers will gather to share their passion for cubing and the pursuit of new personal bests. The competition takes place over two days inside the spectacular tropical garden at Teknostallen, a truly unique setting for fast fingers and fast minds. Multiple events will be held, from the classic 3x3 to several other variations. Expect a weekend filled with achievement, excitement and true cube joy. Enter through the main entrance of Teknostallen. The waiting area will be located under the mezzanine, while the competitions take place on the mezzanine level. There will be great opportunities to purchase food and drinks from the various venues in the building, including Mellom, Glød and Snurr.

As the name suggests, it is crucial to maintain silence during all events. We'll have sufficient amount of breaks when it is ok to make some noise. Эти соревнования включают в себя только дисциплины, на которых необходимо соблюдать тишину - 3х3х3 вслепую, 4х4х4 вслепую, 5х5х5 вслепую, 3х3х3 Мультиблайнд и 3х3х3 на количество ходов. Как следует из названия, чрезвычайно важно сохранять полную тишину во время всех дисциплин. У нас будет достаточное количество перерывов, во время которых можно будет пошуметь.

items.information: * We will be giving out free Penn Cube Day tote bags for competitors. * Current UPenn students are entitled to free registration. Please leave your Penn email in the registration comment and pay the fee. We will refund if you are qualified. * We will have newcomer (competitors attending their first competition) podium for 3×3, based on the result of 3×3 round 1. * We recommend that you arrive at least 15 minutes before your first event because there are no set times for each group. If your first event is later in the day, you do not have to arrive until then. Missing your group risks potential disqualification from the event. * Groups will be posted and sent in an email a few days before the competition. When it is time to compete, groups will be called instead of individual participants. * Food and drinks are NOT permitted inside the main room. You may eat elsewhere in Houston Hall. There are a few restaurants within a ten minute walk/drive. * Live results will be posted on WCA Live.

items.name: GLS Gdańsk II 2026
items.information: Gdańska Liga Speedcubingu to speedcuberska inicjatywa z najdłuższymi tradycjami i niezwykłą historią. Od 2008 roku w różnych lokalizacjach nasze wspaniałe miasto gościło ponad 80 turniejów w oficjalnej formule World Cube Association, w, których łącznie wzięło udział kilka tysięcy zawodników z całego kraju. --- Gdańsk Speedcubing League is an speedcubing initiative with long tradition and extraordinary history. Since 2008 in several different locations our city hosted more than 80 official WCA competitions, where few thousands of competitors could have done their attempts.

items.information: Жарыс қайырымдылық мақсатында ұйымдастырылады. Жарыстан жиналған барлық қаражат туа біткен екіжақты құлақ атрезиясы мен микротия диагнозы қойылған Данелияның еміне бағытталады. Данелия дерлік естімейді, сөйлеуі қиын, бұл оның жалпы дамуына әсер етуде. Қазіргі таңда ол сүйек өткізгіштігі бар есту аппаратын қолданады, алайда ол жиі бұзылып, баланың белсенді өміріне төтеп бере алмайды. Биыл Данелия 5 жасқа толады, және медициналық көрсеткіштер бойынша оған бас сүйегіне имплантация немесе каналопластика операциясы қажет. АҚШ дәрігері ұсынған каналопластика операциясы Данелияның есту қабілетін қалпына келтіріп, есту жолын кеңейтуге және өмір бойы есту аппаратына тәуелді болмауға мүмкіндік беруі мүмкін. Жиналған қаражат тікелей қолма-қол берілмейді. Барлық жарналар ресми түрде «ZHALAIRI» қайырымдылық қоры арқылы қабылданып, Данелияның еміне заңды және ашық түрде бағытталады. Жарыс Алтын сауда орталығында ,3 қабаттары холлда өтеді. Сіздің қолдауыңыз Данелияға толыққанды өмір сүруге үлкен үміт сыйлайды. Баршаңызды қайырымдылық жарысына қатысуға және қолдау көрсетуге шақырамыз English: The competition is organized for charitable purposes. All funds raised during the event will be directed toward the treatment of Danelia, who has been diagnosed with congenital bilateral ear atresia and microtia. Danelia can barely hear and has difficulty speaking, which affects her overall development. Currently, she uses a bone-conduction hearing device; however, it frequently breaks down and cannot withstand an active child’s lifestyle. This year, Danelia turns 5 years old, and according to medical indications, she requires either a skull implantation procedure or canaloplasty surgery. The canaloplasty surgery recommended by a U.S. doctor may help restore Danelia’s hearing, widen the ear canal, and allow her to live without lifelong dependence on a hearing device. The collected funds will not be handed directly in cash. All donations will be officially received through the «ZHALAIRI» charitable foundation and will be legally and transparently allocated to Danelia’s treatment. The competition will take place at Altyn Shopping Center, 3rd floor hall. Your support gives Danelia great hope for a full and happy life. We invite everyone to participate in the charity competition and show their support.

items.name: Kalvskinnet Kubing 2026
items.information: ## 🇳🇴 Informasjon Velkommen til Kalvskinnet Kubing 2026! Denne konkurransen er åpen for alle som ønsker å delta. ### On The Spot Registreringer Det vil bli mulig å registrere seg på lokalet for denne konkurransen. Vi oppfordrer alle allikevel å [registrere seg på nett](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KalvskinnetKubing2026/register) for å sikre at de får plass på konkurransen. ### Førstegangsdeltakere Førstegangsdeltakere er veldig velkommen til å delta. Det stilles ingen krav om hvor rask man må være for å delta, og vi ønsker å se flest mulig velge å delta. Vi ber alle førstegangsdeltakere vennligst lese [Førstegangsdeltakere-fanen](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KalvskinnetKubing2026#70615-forstegangsdeltakere-first-time-competitors). --- ## 🇺🇸 Information Welcome to Kalvskinnet Kubing 2026! The competition is open to all who wish to compete. ### On The Spot Registration Competitors may register on the spot. We strongly advice all competitors to [register online](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KalvskinnetKubing2026/register) to ensure they are able to get a spot. ### First-Time Competitors First-time competitors are very welcome to compete. There are no requirements in regards to how fast one needs to be to compete, and we would like as many people as possible to attend the competition. We would like to ask all first-time competitors to read the [First-Time Competitors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KalvskinnetKubing2026#70615-forstegangsdeltakere-first-time-competitors) tab.

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTI0MjY2LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--8efbb86064c7715684b16e2c61c3057e7be46ee5/IMG_3706.jpeg) ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTI0MjY3LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--1d377905ca8a83b9f95df9338d24320f682f5446/IMG_3705.jpeg) 🇧🇷 **(Português) Brasileiro:** Sua inscrição só será aprovada no site da WCA após a confirmação do pagamento, que deverá ser efetuado de forma antecipada - mais informações na aba Inscrever. Se tiver dificuldades em se inscrever, veja como fazê-lo neste [vídeo](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wLE2OFf9nh8). ❗️**IMPORTANTE** Nesta competição estaremos com uma campanha beneficente que visa a ajuda para os mais necessitados. Também teremos premiação para as 3 pessoas que mais doarem durante os dias de campeonato! Assim, além de nos divertimos, contribuímos para a construção de um mundo melhor. Saiba mais na pagina [Campanha Beneficente](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CuritibaContraoTempo2026#64648-campanha-beneficente) 💵 **PREMIAÇÃO EM DINHEIRO** 💵 Nesta competição, estaremos realizando a premiação em dinheiro para o pódio da modalidade principal do campeonato, o Clock. Todas as informações estão dispostas na página [Premiação em Dinheiro](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CuritibaContraoTempo2026#64649-premiacao-em-dinheiro) Se você estiver participando pela primeira vez, assista este [vídeo](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UHqunxu3rOU) para aprender a competir. Leia o [regulamento](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/portuguese-brazilian/) da WCA antes da competição. Competidores participando pela primeira vez precisam apresentar na competição um documento oficial com nome, data de nascimento e nacionalidade. Sugerimos que você chegue 30 minutos antes do horário da primeira modalidade em que vai competir. Ao se inscrever, você autoriza que a ABRACM, a WCA e seus parceiros utilizem a sua imagem nas fotos e filmagens que forem feitas no evento, de forma gratuita, inclusive para fins comerciais. Teremos premiação para todas as modalidades oficiais e premiação extra-oficial para as modalidades 'Iniciante (primeira competição)', e "Feminino" que tomarão como referência a classificação geral na modalidade '3x3x3'. 🇬🇧 **English:** Your registration will only be approved on the WCA website after payment confirmation, which must be made in advance - more information in the Register tab. If you have any problem registering, watch this [video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4yo7IqbcgOA&t). ❗️❗️**IMPORTANT** This competition will feature a charity campaign to help those most in need. We'll also have prizes for the three people who donate the most during the competition! This way, we'll not only have fun, but we'll also contribute to building a better world. Learn more on the [Charity Campaign](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CuritibaContraoTempo2026#64648-campanha-beneficente) page. 💵 **CASH PRIZES** 💵 In this competition, we will be awarding cash prizes for the podium finishers in the main event, Clock. All information is available on the [Cash Prizes](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CuritibaContraoTempo2026#64649-premiacao-em-dinheiro) page. If this is your first time competing, watch this [video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8) to learn how to compete. Please read the WCA [regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) before the competition. Competitors participating for the first time must present an official document with their name, date of birth and nationality. We suggest you arrive 30 minutes before the first event you're competing in is scheduled to begin. By registering, you authorize ABRACM, WCA, and their partners to use your image in the photos and videos taken at the event, free of charge, including for commercial purposes. We will have awards for all official events, and also unofficial awards to the events 'Beginner (first competition)', and "female" which will consider the final ranking in the '3x3x3' event.

Competitors will be divided into 2 teams, and will work together to try and achieve as many points as possible. items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTQ4NjI3LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--001eafe7db600fd457790fd0f39991232dd12361/CR_GIF.gif) ##### Español ​ **¡Bienvenidos a Contrarreloj - San Andrés Cholula 2026!** ​ San Andrés Cholula se convierte en el campo de batalla de la velocidad, donde **no compites contra otros… compites contra el tiempo**. Cada décima decide, cada centésima define. 3 rondas de las categorías más rápidas. El reto más grande: **vencer al reloj**. ​ Esta competencia es posible gracias al apoyo del **Municipo de San Andrés Cholula** y a la **Presidenta Municipal Guadalupe Cuautle Torres**. ​ Contrarreloj - San Andrés Cholula 2026 es una competencia oficial de la WCA por lo que todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados con el [Reglamento](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/). ​ **AVISO DE FILMACIÓN Y FOTOGRAFÍA** En este evento se tomarán fotografías y videos que podrán ser usados por la Asociación Mexicana de Speedcubing, Team Puebla y el equipo organizador con fines de promoción, documentación y difusión de nuestras actividades. Al asistir, autorizas el uso de tu imagen. ##### English ​ **¡Welcome to Contrarreloj - San Andrés Cholula 2026!** ​ San Andrés Cholula becomes the battlefield of speed, where **you don’t compete against others… you compete against time**. Every tenth matters, every hundredth defines. 3 rounds of the fastest events. items.information: ##### *English version is below* #### **Deutsch:** Wir freuen uns sehr euch Vienna Winter 2026 als ein offizielles WCA Turnier ankündigen zu können. Die Speedcubing Competition wird organisiert von Julian Ostdal, Noah Kirrane, Simon Praschl und Sebastian Feichtinger und delegiert von Viktor Kalmar, Pranjal Khan und Florian Truckenthanner. Diesmal findet die Competition im Jugendgästehaus Brigittenau statt. Die Resultate dieser Competition werden zu den offiziellen WCA World Rankings hinzugefügt. Jeder ist bei diesem Turnier gerne willkommen, unabhängig von der Erfahrung, Alter oder sonstigen Fähigkeiten. Manche Events haben ein spezifisches Zeitlimit, damit wir sicherstellen können den ganzen Tag über im Zeitplan zu bleiben. Es dürfen Puzzles jeder Marke verwendet werden solange sie den WCA Richtlinien entsprechen. Es sind alle Herzlich willkommen! Jeder Teilnehmer darf einen Gast mitbringen. Wir freuen uns besonders auf neue Speedcuber aus Österreich! ----- #### **English:** We are happy to announce the Vienna Winter 2026 as an official WCA Competition. The speedcubing competition is organised by Julian Ostadal, Noah Kirrane, Simon Praschl and Sebastian Feichtinger and delegated by Viktor Kalmar, Pranjal Khan and Florian Truckenthanner. Results of the competition will be added to the official WCA World Rankings. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the day on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors must be familiar with the WCA Regulations. Any puzzle brand may be used during the competition, as long as it complies with the WCA regulations. Every Competitor can bring one guest.

items.information: A inscrição é aberta a qualquer pessoa, de qualquer nacionalidade. Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram feitos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos você compete e no outro ajuda a embaralhar ou sendo juiz. **ATENÇÃO:** Está é uma competição que não terá o Cubo 3x3x3 como uma de suas modalidades. **ATENÇÃO:** Devido ao tamanho do local da competição, apenas um acompanhante será permitido por competidor. Façamos a competição ser possível para todos os competidores! --- Registration is open to any person, from any country. With a view to the smooth running of the competition, by registering for a category, you also undertake to help as a judge or scrambler in that category (as provided for in the WCA rules). In this way, the competition becomes self-sustaining, and the activities are divided among all participants, not becoming heavy for just a few. At least two groups were made in each modality. In one of the groups you compete and in the other you help to scramble or judge. **ATTENTION:** This competition will not have the 3x3x3 Cube as one of its events. **ATTENTION:** Due to the size of the competition's venue, only one guest will be allowed per competitor. Please do not bring more guests than the allowed quantity, let's make the competition possible for all competitors!

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTM1NTU5LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--3a118b424e278701313a1719599eeb8de50cc7ef/Screenshot_2025-10-20_at_8.56.54_PM.png) ### **대한민국 국적이 아닌 선수분들께서는 Korean Championship 2025에 참가 신청을 삼가주시기를 정중히 부탁드립니다.** Korean Championship은 대한민국에서 열리는 가장 중요한 WCA 대회입니다. 본 대회는 대한민국 챔피언을 선발하기 위한 대회인 만큼, 챔피언 타이틀이 대한민국 국적자에게 주어지기를 희망합니다. 다른 대회에는 언제든지 참가를 환영합니다. 모든 종목의 결승 라운드에서는 대한민국 참가자를 위해 결승 라운드 참가 인원의 50% 또는 8명 중 더 적은 수가 우선 배정됩니다. 우선 배정이 적용되는 라운드에서는, 이전 라운드에서 진출하는 참가자 중 대한민국 참가자가 먼저 선발되며, 이후 다른 국적의 상위 참가자가 선발됩니다. 모든 참가자가 [WCA 규정](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/korean/)을 숙지할 것을 강력히 권장합니다. WCA 규정 [1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/korean/#1e2)와 [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/korean/#1f2)에 따라, 모든 참가자는 운영진의 요청이 있을 시 스태프 업무를 수행해야 합니다. --- ### **The organization team kindly asks international competitors NOT to register for Korean Championship 2025.** Korean Championship is the most important WCA competition in Korea. As this competition is held to determine the national champion, we hope that the championship title will be awarded to competitors with Korean nationality. You are always welcome to participate in other competitions. For the final round of all events, 50% or up to 8 of the finalist spots (whichever is smaller) will be reserved for competitors representing the Republic of Korea. In rounds with reserved spots, advancing competitors will first include the top Korean competitors from the previous round, followed by the highest-ranked competitors of other nationalities. All competitors are strongly encouraged to be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). According to WCA Regulations [1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1e2) and [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1f2), all competitors must perform staff duties upon request from the organizers.

Od 2008 roku w różnych lokalizacjach nasze wspaniałe miasto gościło ponad 60 turniejów w oficjalnej formule World Cube Association, w, których łącznie wzięło udział kilka tysięcy zawodników z całego kraju. --- Gdańsk Speedcubing League is an speedcubing initiative with long tradition and extraordinary history. Since 2008 in several different locations our city hosted more than 60 official WCA competitions, where few thousands of competitors could have done their attempts.

items.information: **(Português) Brasileiro** É com grande alegria que anunciamos mais um Capivara! Esse ano, estamos testando pela primeira vez um dia apenas para modalidades silenciosas, e o segundo dia para as modalidades mais populares. Então pedimos para prestar bastante atenção às modalidades em que você está se inscrevendo. Sua inscrição só será aprovada no site da WCA após a confirmação do pagamento correto, que deverá ser efetuado de forma antecipada - mais informações abaixo em "Requisitos para inscrição" (e na hora da inscrição). Se tiver dificuldades em se inscrever, veja como fazer neste [vídeo](https://youtu.be/wLE2OFf9nh8?si=hfp2rKaN8jHPI_RL). É muito importante que você conheça todo o regulamento, que podem ser lido [aqui](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/portuguese-brazilian/). Teremos premiação para todas as modalidades oficiais e premiação extra-oficial para as modalidades 'Feminino' e 'Iniciante', que tomarão como referência a classificação geral na modalidade '3x3x3'. **English** It is in great excitement that we announce a new Capivara! This year, we are testing for the first time one day exclusively to silent events, and the second day for the most popular events. Therefore, we ask you to pay a lot of attention to the events you are registering to. Your registration will only be approved in the WCA website after payment confirmation, which must be made in advance - more information below in "Registration requirements" (and during the registration). If you have any problem on how to register, take a look at this [video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4yo7IqbcgOA). It is very important that you know the regulations, which may be read [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). We will have awards for all official events, and also unofficial awards to the events 'Female' and 'Beginner', which will consider the final ranking in the '3x3x3' event.

items.name: Latvijas Čempionāts 2025

venue.name: [Siguldas Valsts Ģimnāzija](https://svg.lv/)
venue.address: Siguldas Valsts Ģimnāzija, Sigulda, Siguldas novads, LV-2150

items.information: Pēc trīs gadu pārtraukuma Latvijā atgriežas lielākās sacensības – **Latvijas čempionāts** – atdzimis un uzlabots! Sacensībās būs pārstāvētas gandrīz visas oficiālās WCA disciplīnas, kā arī notiks Iesācēju kauss un 3x3x3 kubs ar aizvērtām acīm pāros, lai piešķirtu pasākumam nelielu odziņu. Balvas varēs saņemt tikai Latvijas pilsoņi, taču sacensībās piedalīties aicināti dalībnieki no jebkuras valsts. FMC disciplīnas čempionāts notiks citā datumā. Šīs būs jau piektās sacensības, kas norisināsies Siguldā. ----------------------------------------------------- After a three-year break, the biggest competition in Latvia is back – **Latvian Championship** – reborn and improved! Amost all official WCA events will be featured, along with a Beginners’ Cup and 3x3x3 team-blindfolded to add a little twist to the competition. Only Latvian citizens are eligible for prizes, but participants from any country are welcome to compete. The FMC championship will be held on a different date. This will be the fifth competition to take place in Sigulda. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTMyMjcyLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--fda432baba49bf08fcf745df4e00a01d507ab85b/LV%C4%8CEMPIS2025ssss.png) ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTM1MjY2LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--d2c629bcad5d3a8ac071c808aa84be23cd16d534/cuboss-logo-400px.png)

items.name: Greek Nationals 2025
items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTI5OTU1LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--aac907f1eb0c44b518d47ef44f2346458b3cf2ce/image.png) Η σεζόν κλείνει με το 3ο Εθνικό Πρωτάθλημα Speedcubing το οποίο για πρώτη φορά θα πραγματοποιηθεί στην Βόρεια Ελλάδα και συγκεκεκριμένα στην Θεσσαλονίκη. Ποιοι θα είναι οι καλύτεροι για φέτος; Για 3 μέρες cubers απ όλη τη χώρα και όχι μόνο θα αγωνιστούν για την ανάδειξη των πρωταθλητών του 2025! Η μεγαλύτερη γιορτή του κύβου όπως δεν θα την έχετε ξαναζήσει ποτέ! Παρακαλoύμε διαβάστε αναλυτικά τις επόμενες σελίδες για να βρείτε όλες τις απαραίτητες πληροφορίες. Σημείωση: Για να θεωρείται ολοκληρωμένη μία εγγραφή πρέπει να ολοκληρωθεί το registration στη σελίδα του διαγωνισμού στην WCA **KAI** να γίνει και η πληρωμή του αντιτίμου συμμετοχής με χρήση της τραπεζικής σας κάρτας μέσω της πλατφόρμας πληρωμών stripe που χρησιμοποιεί η WCA, όπως περιγράφεται στις καρτέλες δίπλα. Δείτε αυτά τα βίντεο για να είστε ετοιμασμένοι: [Εγγραφή στη WCA, σε επίσημο διαγωνισμό και πολλά ακόμα. Οδηγός για πρωτάρηδες.](https://youtu.be/RS768gK0Vrg) [Πώς να είσαι κριτής σε διαγωνισμό κύβων.](https://youtu.be/x5KaXXoh7XI) The season wraps up with the 3rd National Speedcubing Championship, which for the very first time will take place in Northern Greece, in the city of Thessaloniki. Who will be the best of the year? For three days, cubers from all over the country – and beyond – will compete to crown the 2025 champions! The biggest cube celebration like you’ve never experienced before! Please read the following tabs very carefully! Note: For a registration to be considered valid, the competitor should both register though the WCA site **AND** pay the registration fee as described in the nexts tabs. Please read the following tabs in detail to find all the necessary information.

As inscrições devem ser realizadas exclusivamente pelo site da WCA, mediante pagamento antecipado da taxa via PIX. A inscrição será confirmada apenas após a validação do pagamento. Para garantir o bom andamento do evento, ao se inscrever em uma modalidade você também assume o compromisso de atuar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria, conforme estabelecido pelas regras da WCA. Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, com as responsabilidades divididas entre todos os competidores. Em cada modalidade haverá, no mínimo, dois grupos: em um deles você competirá e, no outro, ajudará como juiz ou embaralhador. Ao efetuar sua inscrição, você autoriza a AACM, a WCA e seus parceiros a utilizarem gratuitamente sua imagem em fotos e filmagens realizadas durante o evento, inclusive para fins comerciais. --- 🇺🇸 **English:** The competition is open to participants of all ages. Registrations must be made exclusively through the WCA website, with the entry fee paid in advance via PIX. Registration will only be confirmed after payment validation. To ensure the smooth running of the event, by registering for an event you also commit to serving as a judge or scrambler in that category, as established by the WCA regulations. In this way, the competition becomes self-sustainable, with responsibilities shared among all competitors. For each event, there will be at least two groups: in one you will compete, and in the other you will serve as a judge or scrambler. By completing your registration, you authorize AACM, WCA, and their partners to freely use your image in photos and videos taken during the event, including for commercial purposes.

items.name: Dreht's Eich in Ergolding 2025
items.information: **Richtigs Deitsch** Griaß eich mitanand! Seid's recht herzlich willkomm'n bei der **Dreht’s Eich in Ergolding 2025** – da urboarischen Cubing-Competition, wo ned bloß d'Würfel, sondern aa d’Hirnwindung'n auf Hochtour'n laffa! Ob 3x3, 3BLD oder 7x7 – bei uns werd g'dreht, dass da Gummi glüht! Ganz egal, ob's no Anfänger seids, olle erfahrene Speedcuber oder einfach nur zum Zuaschau'n kemmts: Packt's eich zamm, kemmts vorbei und zoagt's, wos in eich steckt – oder lehnt’s eich z'ruck, genießt's de Stimmung und lasst's eich a guade Brezn🥨 schmecka (De miasad's aba seiba kaffa). Mia gfrein uns narrisch auf eich, und denkts dro: **Dreht's eich, aber gscheid!** **English** Hello everyone! A warm welcome to **Dreht’s Eich in Ergolding 2025** – the ultimate Bavarian cubing competition, where not just the cubes, but also your brains will be spinning at full speed! Whether it's 3x3, 3BLD, or 7x7 – we’re turning so fast the rubber’s burning! No matter if you're a beginner, a seasoned speedcuber, or just here to watch: Grab your stuff, come on over, and show us what you've got – or just sit back, soak in the vibe, and enjoy a good pretzel🥨 (you'll have to buy that yourself though). We’re super excited to see you, and don’t forget: **Spin it, and do it right!**

items.name: Cottbus Cubing 2025
items.information: ### Deutsch Herzlich willkommen zur Cottbuser Cubing Competition! Wir freuen uns sehr, euch alle zur ersten offiziellen Speedcubing-Competition in der Lausitz begrüßen zu dürfen! Vom 15. bis 16. November 2025 dreht sich in Cottbus alles um Würfel, Zeiten und jede Menge Spaß. Diese Premiere ist nicht nur ein sportliches Event, sondern auch ein Schritt, die Cubing-Community in Brandenburg weiter wachsen zu lassen. Wir sind stolz, mit euch gemeinsam Cubing-Geschichte in der Lausitz zu schreiben. Wir wünschen allen Teilnehmenden spannende Wettkämpfe, faire Duelle und vor allem viel Freude am Würfeln! [Event-Trailer](https://youtube.com/shorts/Va4iRMysVpQ?si=ID4au8HW_QbFkCFX) **Bitte lies dir alle Tabs sorgfältig durch, damit du mit dem Ablaufplan und allen Modalitäten vertraut bist.** ### English Welcome to the Cottbuser Cubing Competition! We’re very excited to welcome you all to the first official speedcubing competition in the Lausitz region! From November 15 to 16, 2025, everything in Cottbus will revolve around cubes, times, and a whole lot of fun.This premiere is not just a sporting event, but also a milestone in helping the cubing community grow here in Brandenburg. We’re proud to be making cubing history in the Lausitz together with you. We wish all participants exciting solves, fair competition, and – above all – lots of fun with the cubes! [Event-Trailer](https://youtube.com/shorts/Va4iRMysVpQ?si=ID4au8HW_QbFkCFX) **Please read all tabs carefully so you are familiar with the schedule and all modalities.** ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTEzOTkxLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--afaa0c7e07a9256263f11b2588651c4929c99f85/Logo_Web.png)

items.name: Trondheim 3x3 Day 2025
items.information: ## 🇳🇴 Informasjon Velkommen til Trondheim 3x3 Day 2025! Denne konkurransen er åpen for alle som ønsker å delta. ### On The Spot Registreringer Det vil bli mulig å registrere seg på lokalet for denne konkurransen. Vi oppfordrer alle allikevel å [registrere seg på nett](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/Trondheim3x3Day2025/register) for å sikre at de får plass på konkurransen. ### Førstegangsdeltakere Førstegangsdeltakere er veldig velkommen til å delta. Det stilles ingen krav om hvor rask man må være for å delta, og vi ønsker å se flest mulig velge å delta. Vi ber alle førstegangsdeltakere vennligst lese [Førstegangsdeltakere-fanen](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/Trondheim3x3Day2025/#63531-forstegangsdeltakere-first-time-competitors). --- ## 🇺🇸 Information Welcome to Trondheim 3x3 Day 2025! The competition is open to all who wish to compete. ### On The Spot Registration Competitors may register on the spot. We strongly advice all competitors to [register online](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/Trondheim3x3Day2025/register) to ensure they are able to get a spot. ### First-Time Competitors First-time competitors are very welcome to compete. There are no requirements in regards to how fast one needs to be to compete, and we would like as many people as possible to attend the competition. We would like to ask all first-time competitors to read the [First-Time Competitors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/Trondheim3x3Day2025/#63531-forstegangsdeltakere-first-time-competitors) tab.

If you are unfamiliar with this style of a competition, please read the "[What is a Favorites Competition?](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ArizonaFavorites2025#64471-what-is-a-favorites-competition)" tab. Due to the style of this competition, the schedule may change after registration has closed to allot the appropriate amount of time to each event based on registration numbers. Due to scheduling so many events, we have a few events that overlap. You can still register to compete in both events; you will just do one event's solves and upon finishing, compete in the other event.

items.information: **Bem-vindos ao primeiro campeonato do Sudoeste do Paraná!** 🇧🇷 Sua inscrição só será aprovada no site da WCA após a confirmação do pagamento, que deverá ser efetuado de forma antecipada - mais informações na aba [Inscrever](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/DoisVizinhosOpen2025/register). Se tiver dificuldades em se inscrever, veja como fazer neste [Guia para competidores novatos](https://docs.google.com/document/d/19vX1Rr681jMj1dmgBmOoBVpgT8KutJ_JmzuVoJK_R30/edit?usp=sharing). Todos os competidores devem apresentar documento válido com foto no credenciamento. Competidores participando pela primeira vez devem apresentar um documento oficial que contenha foto, nome completo, data de nascimento e nacionalidade. Favor ler o [Regulamento da WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) antes da competição. Teremos premiação para todas as modalidades oficiais e premiação extra-oficial para o feminino e para iniciantes na modalidade 'Cubo 3x3x3' (que tomarão como base a classificação geral na primeira rodada). Após o término do prazo das inscrições, serão aceitas inscrições no local do campeonato apenas na modalidade 3x3x3, no valor de R$ 35,00. O Competidor deverá chegar com 30 minutos de antecedência e a inscrição só será aceita caso ainda haja vagas. --- **Welcome to the first competition in the Southwest of the state of Paraná!** 🇺🇸 Your registration will only be approved on the WCA website after payment confirmation, which must be made in advance - more information in the [Register](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/DoisVizinhosOpen2025/register) tab. If you have any problem registering, read this [Guide for newcomers](https://docs.google.com/document/d/19vX1Rr681jMj1dmgBmOoBVpgT8KutJ_JmzuVoJK_R30/edit?usp=sharing). All competitors must present a valid photo ID at the check-in. Competitors participating for the first time must present an official document containing a photo, full name, date of birth, and nationality. Please read the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) before the competition. There will be awards for all official events, and also unofficial awards for female competitors and for beginners in the '3x3x3 Cube' event (which will be based on the ranking of the first round). After the registration period ends, registrations will be accepted at the competition venue only for the 3x3x3 event, for BRL 35.00. Competitors must arrive 30 minutes in advance and registration will only be accepted if there are still registration slots available. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTIzMzQyLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--50ba046bdd4bc45b71c5b6e35a6c12a4d2d8f75b/dv%20open.jpg)
